items.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
items.content: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

items.title: Data center demand drives 66% surge in natural gas power plant costs
items.content: Natural gas power plant costs have nearly doubled in two years and take 23% longer to build as data center electricity demand skyrockets.
